name: ReCode
description: ReCode is a comprehensive robustness evaluation benchmark for code generation models. It assesses model robustness against over 30 natural code perturbations that preserve semantic meaning, using execution-based metrics to evaluate worst-case behavior under each perturbation.
reputation: A newer robustness benchmark that has been cited in code-generation robustness work, but it is not yet as widely adopted as HumanEval or MBPP.
notes: Includes 30+ code perturbations on docstrings, names, syntax, and format; verified by human annotators; evaluates robustness on HumanEval, MBPP, and derived tasks.
